nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_12V down to VCC_5V for motor‑driver supply and LDO input. Provides the 5 V rail to downstream modules. No local power input port – VIN_12V is a global external rail.
Motor power to 5V Buck converter

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO converts VCC_5V to VCC_3V3 for MCU, stepper‑driver IO rails and flash. Supplies all 3.3 V logic domains. Owns the VCC_3V3 rail distribution point.
5V to 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 core. Runs at VCC_3V3, configures both TMC2209 drivers via shared single‑wire UART (UART_TMC) with unique address pins (MS1/MS2). Generates STEP, DIR and EN signals per channel. Hosts SPI master to flash for motion‑parameter storage.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 channel A stepper driver. Powered at VCC_3V3 (logic) and motor supply from external system. Receives configuration via shared UART_TMC line and unique address pins MS1_AD0 / MS2_AD1. STEP, DIR and ENN inputs driven by MCU. Exposes diagnostic pins but they remain internal for this macro plan.
Stepper motor driver (channel A)
